objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction) that passes through creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based prefix and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document (editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on each revision.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Configurable period for validity extension check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation (default 10 years).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: MS Office format (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) of the editable source.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data or IT applications.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status mirroring the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object linked to a document that is not subject to the main release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional info is published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal request proposing changes to an existing released document, managed and tracked within the document cockpit.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, requiring a decision on continued validity, revision or invalidation.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a document and archive it, processed via a defined workflow.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated/archived document, restricted to the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document lifecycle activities in one or more roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System/license role assigned to the user (Reader, Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or acknowledgement authorizations and distribution membership.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type of group (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A per-document list of User Groups and persons controlling email notification and acknowledgement distribution upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: An automated multi-step approval or processing sequence (release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement).

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Category of workflow (Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new documents to provide standard structure and TAG fields.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational unit in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A business unit, department or location that can be linked to documents for scoping and authorization.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document information object is created by attaching it in the system and selecting a document type and template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type selected during creation.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The author or co-author modifies the content of a document using the integrated editing client.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are entered or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: A workflow participant completes a workflow step with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: signature_step
attributes.description: The workflow step being signed (Creation, Review, Release).

evts.name: submit_for_release
evts.description: The author or co-author initiates the 3-step release workflow for a document.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness within the release workflow.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Technical or formal review.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling it for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The system automatically makes the released document visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights user creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: The document author schedules and documents implementation of a change proposal, creating a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is marked as completed and removed from the document display.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system generates a validity extension request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author/reviewer) processes the validity extension, confirming continued validity.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally initiator/reviewer) reviews and approves the override request.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; all rights except the archive group are revoked and archiving begins.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document and its attachments are restored to active status with a new version.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and User Groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and User Groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document via a workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates the released content of a document into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is reviewed and released via a workflow.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to users or user groups for a document.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after the archive duration has expired.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is linked with a main Document.
An Additional Info object is supplementary to a Document.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed within a Document.
A Validity Extension Request is linked to the Document whose validity is being checked.
An Override Request is created for a specific Document to invalidate it.
A Reactivation Request references the archived Document to be reactivated.
A Document can reference another Document (e.g. local extension referencing original).
A Document is created based on a Document Template defined for its type.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document for notification and acknowledgement.
A Distribution List contains User Groups whose members receive distribution.
A Distribution List can contain individual Users (persons) for direct distribution.
A User is a member of one or more User Groups that grant roles and authorizations.
A Document can be linked to Organizational Units for scoping.
A Document can be made visible in specific Clients in a multi-client system.
